Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “sunny, mild day” and assumed only a ~10°F rise from 41°F, then chose the closest option (41°F) to that estimate. This ignored typical diurnal warming on a mild, sunny day, where afternoon temps are far more likely in the 70s; the correct choice is 78°F.
